maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem about recurring KV eviction spikes. Need a compact runbook with exact triage steps, safe command snippets, owners, and deadlines.

kevin: I can own the runbook PR. Plan: 3-step triage, command cheat-sheet, rollback.

sam: I'll add the root-cause note (prefix skew -> KV growth) and attach a small simulation harness.

lisa: Product needs an explicit rollback step and a documented opt-in config for Dedicated customers.

akshay: oncall: please include an "approved mitigation" action so we can trigger fixes from the alert UI instead of pasting commands.

maria: Draft triage (proposal): 1) Verify: `sum(rate(kv_evictions_total[1m])) by (model) > 50` or `model_kv_miss_rate > 0.2` 2) Contain: `redwoodctl models patch <m> --set cache.read_only=true` + emergency scale 3) Failover: shift traffic to quantized fallback if p95 > 500ms for 2m.

kevin: Commands to include in PR: `redwoodctl models patch model-foo --set cache.read_only=true`, `redwoodctl capacity scale --pool model-foo-pool --add-replicas 2`, `redwoodctl traffic shift --from model-foo --to model-foo-quantized --percent 100`. Will open PR today.

maria: Owner/timeline: kevin -> PR by Fri EOD (1733520000), sam -> tests by Tue (1733692800), maria -> staging smoke & merge by Thu (1733875600).

lisa: I'll draft the product-notify template and rollback wording for the runbook.

akshay: Filing infra ticket for mitigation button: INFRA-1422.

runbook-bot: Created action RB-921 assigned to kevin, due 1733520000.

kevin: I'll add a TL;DR at the top for oncall and ping reviewers Friday morning.

maria: Please update the postmortem action tracker when tasks complete. Meeting to verify merged runbook: Monday 10am PT. If anything slips, escalate here. :thumbsup:
